name: DevDesk
description: Desktop Developer Command Center built with Electron, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and SQLite

scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-env.mjs && node scripts/ensure-ports.mjs && pnpm -r --parallel dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node scripts/sync-env.mjs && node scripts/ensure-ports.mjs 8200 && pnpm --filter frontend dev
scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/sync-env.mjs && node scripts/ensure-ports.mjs 8300 && pnpm --filter backend dev
scripts.build: pnpm install -y && pnpm --filter frontend run build && pnpm --filter backend run build && pnpm --filter desktop run build
